# iCloud session for TestICloudSession: greeting capabilities, CONDSTORE,
# COPYUID, the move as COPY + STORE \Deleted + UID EXPUNGE, IDLE, a dropped
# connection and a reconnect. Responses are hand-written after RFC 3501,
# 4315 and 7162; the capabilities are from the ICloud profile.

S: {icloud.greeting}
C: {t} LOGIN "atrium.test@icloud.com" "app-specific password"
S: {t} OK [CAPABILITY {icloud.authcaps}] User atrium.test logged in
C: {t} SELECT INBOX (CONDSTORE)
S: * FLAGS (\Answered \Flagged \Draft \Deleted \Seen $NotJunk NotJunk $Junk Junk)
S: * OK [PERMANENTFLAGS (\Answered \Flagged \Draft \Deleted \Seen $NotJunk NotJunk $Junk Junk)] Limited
S: * 3 EXISTS
S: * 0 RECENT
S: * OK [UIDVALIDITY 1544650101] UIDs valid
S: * OK [UIDNEXT 304] Predicted next UID
S: * OK [HIGHESTMODSEQ 81250] Highest
S: {t} OK [READ-WRITE] SELECT completed

C/ {t} UID FETCH 1:\* \(UID( (FLAGS|MODSEQ)){2}\) \(CHANGEDSINCE 81200\)
S: * 2 FETCH (MODSEQ (81230) UID 302 FLAGS (\Seen))
S: * 3 FETCH (UID 303 FLAGS (\Seen \Flagged) MODSEQ (81250))
S: {t} OK FETCH completed

C: {t} UID COPY 301:302 "Archive"
S: {t} OK [COPYUID 1544650202 301:302 900:901] COPY completed
C: {t} UID STORE 301:302 +FLAGS.SILENT (\Deleted)
S: {t} OK STORE completed
C: {t} UID EXPUNGE 301:302
S: * 1 EXPUNGE
S: * 1 EXPUNGE
S: {t} OK EXPUNGE completed

C: {t} IDLE
S: + idling
S: * 2 EXISTS
C: DONE
S: {t} OK IDLE terminated

# The server drops the connection under a pending command.
C: {t} NOOP
! close

! accept
S: {icloud.greeting}
C: {t} LOGIN "atrium.test@icloud.com" "app-specific password"
S: {t} NO [AUTHENTICATIONFAILED] Authentication failed
C: {t} LOGIN "atrium.test@icloud.com" "app-specific password"
S: {t} OK [CAPABILITY {icloud.authcaps}] User atrium.test logged in
C: {t} LOGOUT
S: * BYE LOGOUT received
S: {t} OK LOGOUT completed
